findings.quote: Samuel had given it to him at Cadaques two summers ago, and Leo had named it right then
findings.claim: Two facts contradict canon in one sentence: the fossil was not a gift from Samuel — Leo found it himself among the rocks — and it was found one summer before the story, not two. Two summers before is the observatory's row.
findings.fix: Leo finds the fossil himself at Cadaques, one summer ago; keep the naming, which is canon; keep Samuel out of the sentence.

iterations.notes: Re-scored by the same critic on the patched draft. The substituted sentence corrects the error completely: Leo now finds the fossil himself one summer prior, as canon requires, and nothing else in the chapter became inconsistent because of it. No late findings raised.
